scenarios.prompt: Show species occurrences within 5 kilometers of Lugano, Switzerland.
scenarios.ui_text: AEGIS Search Geodata Settings Start new chat History Show conversation history Show species occurrences within 5 kilometers of Lugano, Switzerland. Here's the map of species occurrences within 5 km of Lugano, Switzerland. Location resolved: Lugano, Circolo di Lugano ovest, Distretto di Lugano, Ticino, Switzerland (city; confidence ~0.83). Data retrieved: GBIF species occurrences, searched within a 5 km radius of Lugano. 300 occurrence records were returned and are rendered as a clustered point layer over the default basemap. The map rendered successfully and the layer is visible. Sample of species present (from the returned records): Helleborus niger, Trachycarpus fortunei, Hepatica nobilis, Medicago sativa, Primula vulgaris, Asplenium trichomanes, Galinsoga quadriradiata, Senecio vulgaris, Lathyrus vernus. Important caveats: This is a bounded sample, not a complete inventory. GBIF matched ~142,750 records in the search area, but the interactive result is capped at 300 records. Absence of a species here does not mean it is absent from the area. Occurrence quality, coordinate uncertainty, and licensing vary by contributing dataset. Attribution: GBIF.org and contributing datasets. No single download DOI applies; contributing dataset licences must be acknowledged. If you'd like, I can narrow the scope (e.g., a specific species group or a smaller radius) or adjust the map view.
